text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One early afternoon, with Ikuno Dictus's 
debut race drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(This afternoon's training focuses on 
weights. In that case, the lunch menu 
should be...――)
――Ikuno-san!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my— Are you about to have lunch as 
well, McQueen?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ikuno-san happened to be here, so I 
spoke to her, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, um... would it be 
alright if we had lunch together?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Mejiro McQueen-san. A member of the 
prestigious Mejiro family that has 
produced countless distinguished 
Umamusume, and...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(My roommate at the dorm. A gifted friend 
whom I deeply respect, carrying the weight 
of a prestigious house while working 
tirelessly.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Shall we get going right away? What would 
you like to eat, Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Taking today's training into 
account, something easy to digest would 
be—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's see which seats are 
open...
—Oh, it's McQueen and Ikuno-chan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hallo hallo~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ryan and Ines—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Mejiro Ryan-san. Like McQueen-san, she's 
an Umamusume of the Mejiro family—a 
passionate and dependable person with an 
extraordinary love for muscles.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Ines Fujin-san. Bright and refreshing, 
she runs with a momentum that seems to 
cleave the wind. And above all else... 
she's a kind soul who cherishes her 
family.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Those two, McQueen-san, and I... we are 
all from the same racing generation.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You two haven't eaten yet, right? Would 
you like to join us?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. What about you, 
McQueen-san—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course, not at all. Let us classmates 
share a table together.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
――Have you thought about what comes next 
after your debut race, Ikuno-chan?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm still discussing it with Trainer, but 
considering my distance aptitude, we're 
building my future training around making 
the mile my main battlefield.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... As expected, you really have your 
act together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The mile, huh... In that case, are you 
aiming for the Oka Sho somewhere down the 
line?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It depends on my Junior Class record, of 
course, but if possible, I'd like to start 
with the Oka Sho and challenge the Triple 
Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume, the Classic races are 
naturally something I aspire to as well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You can definitely run the Tiara route, 
Ikuno-san. Please aim for it with 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Are you all truly aiming for the 
Classic Triple Crown path, after all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I fully intend to face it with 
pride, as befits a Mejiro horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The “Classic Triple Crown.” It is the 
collective term for three races: the 
Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), and Kikuka Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(A once-in-a-lifetime race only run during 
the Classic year, a glorious battleground 
to decide the pinnacle of the generation—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Without exception, the winners etch their 
names into history and are praised as 
shining figures. It is the supreme honor 
coveted by so many Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(And paired with this Classic Triple 
Crown, there exists another pinnacle—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(That is the "Triple Tiara." A magnificent 
stage contested across three races: the 
Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba, and the Shuka 
Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Just like the Classic Triple Crown, this 
is a once-in-a-lifetime race... However, 
there are many key differences.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(As a major factor, while the "Classic 
Triple Crown" consists of medium and 
long-distance races—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(One factor is that the Triple Tiara 
consists of mile and medium-distance 
races. Therefore—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(If I aim for the top in the mile, 
inevitably, the Tiara route emerges as the 
path—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like everyone and I will be 
running on different paths from here on, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you can keep running for a long time... 
all the way to the Senior Class, we might 
just compete together someday.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Personally, I'd like to look forward to 
that as something to enjoy in the future."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— If fulfilling our respective duties 
brings our paths together... that would be 
truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Things to look forward to in the future, 
huh? I don't know what's gonna happen, 
but... that kind of has a nice ring to 
it."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I want to race you at full 
power someday too, Ikuno-chan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So I'll look forward to it in the future 
too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. ...I am honored.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Eheh—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! While we're at it, there was 
something I wanted to ask you about—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That afternoon. A little before starting 
training with Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back in the Trainer's office, I was 
rethinking the race rotation for Ikuno 
Dictus's debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As part of gathering information for 
that, I had been looking into Umamusume 
from the same generation as Ikuno Dictus, 
but—"
choice_data_list:
(The competition is fierce this year as 
well...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan, 
Umamusume of the prestigious Mejiro 
family—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby, an Umamusume of the 
"Illustrious Clan" who wields immense 
influence not only in the racing world, 
but across countless other spheres.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her mother was a famous Umamusume who made 
her mark on the Triple Tiara route. And 
Daiichi Ruby is expected to follow in her 
footsteps...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Ikuno Dictus decides to pursue the 
Tiara route, there's a high chance she'll 
be a rival to contend with.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I pondered the harshness of the road 
ahead, where brilliant and formidable 
rivals lay in wait—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, Trainer. Now then, 
let us begin today's training as 
scheduled.
choice_data_list: Ah, it's already that time, huh.
Ah, it's already time, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Is there something troubling her, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having the haze in my heart pointed out 
directly left me momentarily at a loss for 
words. Realizing there was no point in 
hiding it anymore—
choice_data_list:
...I was just thinking a bit about the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: About what lies ahead...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I see. As you say, it is true that many 
of the people around me have had high 
expectations placed upon them from an 
early age.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It is true that the journey will be that 
much harsher. However— that is not enough 
to daunt me."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If anything... it's quite the opposite.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
When strong Umamusume gather, it 
inevitably raises the bar for victory even 
higher.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Heading into a race, I strive to surpass 
these limits by utilizing everything at my 
disposal... and victory or defeat clearly 
measures the success of that utilization.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...In short, racing against someone 
strong inevitably forces me to perform at 
full capacity in order to win—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The feedback we obtain... It means the 
quantity and quality of our experience 
will improve even further.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, if I can run in more of such 
races than anyone else, I will be able to 
draw closer to becoming the strongest 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
By doing so, her racing ability will be 
proven, and the value of 'maintenance' and 
'management' will also be proven—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am delighted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those words came precisely because Ikuno 
Dictus possessed an unyielding 
determination to "run longer than anyone 
else."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. However, please do not 
forget.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I can speak up like this without flinching 
because I have a Trainer who believes in 
my path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I straighten my posture and steady my mind 
once more. If I keep relying on her 
steadfastness, I will only betray the 
trust she's placed in me...!
choice_data_list:
...Alright! Shall we get started today 
too?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both in her debut race and beyond, she 
would march forward without fearing any 
formidable rival. With that, her resolve 
was set—
